note: What a server sends to set how long until one of a unit's spells is ready.

bits.name: speakWhenReady
bits.note: Set where the unit says something once the wait is over.

bits.name: summonerSpell
bits.note: Set where the slot is a summoner slot rather than one of the unit's own.

bits.name: unknown
bits.note: Purpose undetermined. A server leaves these as it found them, so they carry values it never wrote for this message.

fields.name: timeLeft
fields.note: How long is left, in seconds.

fields.name: outOf
fields.note: The length the client shows that remainder against, in seconds.
